name: Haramase Simulator
source: Haramase Simulator is an open ended visual-novel focused on the impregnation 'fetish'. In it, you are free to roam around and impregnate as many women as you can, provided you know how to manage your stamina, money and other stats. The game is currently being worked on by a bunch of anons, and it's in the very early stages of development, so expect it to be a little rough around the edges. The characters are an ensemble of some of our favourite hentai girls, shamelessly ripped off from commercial Japanese visual novels.
translation:
《Haramase Simulator》是一款围绕“使女性怀孕”这一癖好的开放式视觉小说。你可以自由探索，尽可能让更多女性怀孕，但必须管理好体力、金钱和其他属性。

本作目前由一群匿名开发者制作，仍处于早期阶段，因此整体还有些粗糙。角色则是一群从商业日本视觉小说中毫不掩饰地借鉴而来的、开发者最喜欢的工口游戏女孩。
